blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The race to the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International crown has gotten even tighter with just 11 delegates advancing to the next stage of the competition, including the Philippines’ Gabrielle Galapia. The competition at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City has gotten more intense with the third elimination round of the competition. Sri Lanka’s Sandeepa Sewmini Don Samarasinghe Disanayake earned her Top 11 placement with the help of the public through the online voting platform.
